intended_claim: Under the locked centered-Procrustes initialization, 1024 fitted anchors, 50% inclusive paid exposure, lambda 10, two updates and declared CPU arithmetic, ARC2 Tangent2 improves mean nDCG@10 over the matched Chordal2 and ordinary EuclideanResidual2 controls on FiQA development for MiniLM-L6 to DistilRoBERTa.
what_results_support: Both locked MiniLM primary contrasts are positive under the original K4-family interval rule.
The chordal contrast supports removal of the radial target component within these evolving two-step ridge trajectories, conditional on the locked configuration.
The Euclidean contrast establishes superiority over the specified ordinary residual control in this configuration.

mechanism_scope.chordal_isolates: Including versus removing the radial target component under a shared prediction-norm scaling rule, with the downstream consequences of evolving trajectories.
mechanism_scope.chordal_does_not_isolate: Identical second-step states, identical target norms, identical later-state radii, or all possible projection/residual algorithms.
mechanism_scope.norm_matched_meaning: Common prediction-norm scaling rule at a common state; not equality of target norms.
